balls.text: Dhoni tries to blast down the ground but gets a bottom edge towards fine leg, Dhoni sprints back and completes his half-century off the final ball. It's been manic
driven with power to the fielder at deep cover

what was that?! Bravo had moved towards leg but the ball was wide outside off, on a length. Bravo lunged at it, freeing his arms and throwing his bat with all he had. He was almost off the ground as he made contact with the ball, or one leg was. He ended up carving it flat over the point boundary. Jaw-dropping stuff.
short ball, and it's gone the distance. Bravo had plenty of time to wind up and pull off the front foot with tremendous force, sending the ball 85 metres over midwicket
Bravo moves outside off stump and Kulkarni sprays the ball wide, that was far too wide outside off stump
Dhoni plays the paddle sweep but can't beat short fine leg

a low full toss, nearly in the blockhole, Dhoni forces the ball to long on, the batsmen race back for the second and Pollard kicks the ground in disappointment after throwing wide of the stumps at the batsman's end
short of a length and Bravo pulls the ball high towards deep midwicket, where it falls short of the boundary but goes safely over it. 18 off that Malinga over.
in the blockhole on off stump, Dhoni gets down low and plays to short third man

there's the helicopter shot, and the ball has disappeared flat over the midwicket boundary. Dhoni goes back to change a yorker to a full length ball and flicks it with a lot of bottom hand. Now we've seen all of Dhoni's repertoire tonight
good length on off stump, Bravo pushes to point and runs
too full outside off, Bravo lunges forward and blazes the ball over the leaping fielder at extra cover, Bravo had lots of width outside off
Bravo closes the face of the bat and gets a leading edge that goes towards long off
Bravo walks towards the off side and clips a full toss off his pad through square leg

Pollard makes a stupendous save on the wide long-on boundary. Dhoni hammered the ball, so flat and  hard. It was bouncing over the boundary but Pollard dived in the nick of time, using his large reach to bring the ball down
driven to wide long on and Dhoni and Bravo race the first so they can sprint the second
seems so effortless, most of the fielders in the deep are on the leg side, so Dhoni moves towards leg and lofts a full ball from leg and middle stump towards the extra cover boundary
played to cover point for a single

Bravo walks outside off stump and RP Singh bowls the ball wider outside off, outside the tram line, Bravo tried to blast through cover but missed. Good call from the umpire Dharmasena not to call it wide
Dhoni stays in his crease to a length ball and drives it towards wide long-on, he is batting and running with urgency
short of a length outside off, Bravo stays back and cuts towards deep point
Malinga's bowled a full toss on the pads when fine leg is in the circle, Bravo glances and places the ball between the keeper and short fine leg
in the blockhole outside off, Dhoni squeezes it through point
a low full toss on middle stump, Dhoni swings it through midwicket, giving Smith a long chase from deep backward square leg. He slid and tried to stop the ball with his feet but failed
the slower ball on a good length around off, Bravo drops the ball close on the off side and runs
Bravo goes back to drop the short of a length ball towards the off side
played off the back foot towards cover
after the full balls were punished, Kulkarni predictably shortens his length, Dhoni is ready and waiting, swivelling to pull the ball past short fine leg
again the length is full, and Dhoni drives along the ground through cover, super placement
too full and Dhoni simply drills it with a lot of power between Bravo and the stumps at the bowler's end, lots of bottom hand in that shot

Jadeja is second time unlucky. He threw his bat at a length delivery angling across him and made contact with the bottom of the bat, wide outside off stump. The ball went high in the air and Rohit ran back from point to take a fine catch, watching the ball as it fell over his head

that's out of here! A length ball which Dhoni got under and heaved at with might towards long-on. That's gone over the roof of the Chinnaswamy Stadium. Tremendous. The biggest of the tournament? 112 metres, so it was.

Jadeja's been let off! Dhoni had come out of his crease to flick, he missed and was hit on the pads. The ball fell close on the off side and Jadeja ran a long way down from the non-striker's end. Dhoni sent him back. Franklin ran to the ball, picked up and threw at the bowler's end. RP Singh had come running in from mid-off and he broke the stumps with Jadeja well short. He broke the stumps after failing to collect the ball
full ball outside off, driven on the front foot towards cover
punched off the back foot to cover

that's cleared the backward square leg boundary ... oh no it hasn't! Kulkarni's taken a splendid catch. Hussey flicked a length ball with the angle into him and he seemed to have placed it into the gap. Kulkarni ran to his left from deep square leg, caught the ball in the nick of time, and was able to stay inside play by arresting his momentum
a full ball on the pads, meat and drink for Hussey, who glances and beats the fielder at short fine leg. Even I might have got bat on that
Pollard veers wide of the crease and then bowls a good length ball on middle and off, Hussey stays in his crease and plays on the off side
the fuller, slower ball. Dhoni drives to long on
and a terrific start for the captain, Pollard strays on to the pads and Dhoni flicks it in the air and into the gap on the midwicket boundary
driven on the front foot to long on

caught on the edge of the straight boundary! Badri gave Pollard the charge, the ball was short of a length and straight. Badri hit through the line, lofting the ball on the up, over the bowler's head. Rohit ran to his left from long-on and judged the catch well because he was on the move when he reached the ball
a slower ball on leg stump, Hussey turns the ball off his pads to square leg
full on the pads this time, Hussey flicks through square.
a short ball to follow the full one, but same result. Hussey pulls extremely hard and into the gap at deep midwicket
a full ball on the pads, Hussey clears his front foot and lofts the ball into the gap between long on and deep midwicket
Badri mis-times the pull, he was trying to hit against the angle going across him and the ball falls short of Harbahjan running in from midwicket
RP bowls a full ball nearly in the blockhole on leg stump, Hussey gets hit on the pad as he tries to nudge towards square
short of a length angling across the right-hander from over the wicket, Badri swats towards long off
ends the over with a yorker which Hussey plays on the leg side, three runs off it, after the abundance of runs in the previous two
that is a terrific short ball from Malinga, fast and outside off, Hussey shaped to pull but decided against hitting against the angle going across him from over the wicket
short of a length outside off, Badri stays in his crease and opens the face to steer to third man
a straight, very low full toss, Badri mis-times the drive towards the bowler
Malinga tries to bowl another yorker but strays down leg side
Badri makes room by moving towards leg but has to dig out a yorker back to the bowler
the slower ball outside off stump, steered from the crease to Pollard at backward point
the deft reverse paddle from Hussey! He places it fine, between the keeper and short third man
intense stuff from Super Kings! Hussey charges, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it towards long-off, where Pollard leaps at full stretch but watches the ball just go over him
slower ball drifting across the right-hander, Badri drives in front of point
huge hit over deep midwicket, Badri clears his front leg and swings freely, sending the ball into the stands. He's taking charge of this innings
drifts down leg side but Harbhajan gets away with it, Hussey goes down on one knee and paddles straight to short fine leg
played off the back foot on the leg side
short of a length angling into the right-hander, Badri opens the face and steers to third man
Badri heaves across the line once again and gets a bottom edge past his stumps to the fine leg boundary
short ball and Badri pulls the ball flat towards deep square leg, where Malinga seemed to have it covered. The ball fell short of him and bounced really high, flying over Malinga's head
Badri goes low to paddle the ball but is hit on the pad by a slower one
the slower ball bowled fuller on middle and off stump, driven to long off on the front foot
short ball first up and Hussey simply pulls it into the gap on the midwicket boundary, didn't hit it too hard, focused on placing it
on the leg stump, he was giving room yet again but was able to only push it back to the bowler
outside the off stump, wants to swing it away, gets an under edge and easily beats the fine-leg, Sachin Tendulkar.
full-toss, on the off stump, driven to the left of the bowler, misfielded by the bowler, allows a single

on the off stump, tries to run it down to third-man misses and Karthik not only whips them off in a hurry but also makes a long appeal, forcing the leg umpire to call for the third umpire, not-out given
on the leg side, played away to fine-leg and he had hit it slow, are able to get back for the second
on the middle stump, gives himself room, pushes to the point fielder for no run
outside the off stump, pitched right up and driven but straight to extra-cover and they get no run
on the middle stump, angles into the batsman, bit of bounce for Pollard and it is played away to the leg side for a single
pitched right up to the bat, outside the off stump, driven to the sweeper for a single
on the leg stump, bit of deviation into the batsman, hits the pads and it rolls to the leg side, wanted a single but Pollard runs quickly and prevents it
another one outside the off stump, short of length, outside edge through to third-man and a single
outside the off stump, cut away through point and they get a single, misfield by Rayadu at sweeper allows them to come back for the second
goes down the pitch, flicks it away the fuller ball to mid-wicket for a single
outside the off stump, short of length, on the back foot, pushes to the covers
short from RP, wants to go for the pull, gets a bit of an under edge and it beats the wicket-keeper and the fine-leg for a four!
gives himself some room by moving to the leg side, it was on a length, pushed to the off side
on his pads, pushed to the leg side and they are quickly off for a single before the short mid-wicket comes into the picture
on the middle, short of length and there was slight deviation away from the batsman, beats the outside edge, the feet were going nowhere for Hussey
another yorker to the batsman, who is on the back foot, dug out well, goes to third-man for a single
short ball, fended away to the leg side, was awkwardly played, and they still get a single
yorker on the middle, defended well, on the off stump, bit of hesitation and then they go for a single, Smith from point has a shy and had that hit, Badri would have been out by a yard
outside the off stump and pitched up, Hussey eases it through the extra-cover region for a four, beats the in-field and Harbhajan at mid-off fails in his chase.
on the pads as well, flicked away to fine-leg for a single, Badri is through to the non-striker's end
on the middle stump, bit of swing, pushed to the short mid-wicket, it was not too quick
outside the off stump, short of length, still some swing, he is on the back foot, punched to the off side and to the fielder
on the of stump, defended on the back foot
outside the off stump, lot of width for the batsman, he frees his arms and smashes over the covers for a boundary! Good counter-attacking from Hussey
outside the off stump, pitched up and driven to the covers, straight to the fielder
outside the off stump and this time it has left away by the batsman through to the keeper
edged and through the slips for a four! It was outside the off stump, swinging in from one pitched up, went for the drive, gets an edge through to the third-man for four
well bowled again, on the middle stump and swinging back to the batsman, who defends it and wants a single, Badri hesitated a little before calling him through for a quick one
a bit of a shimmy down the wicket, opens the face of the bat, through to third-man for a single
on the middle stump, angling in before deviating slightly away and defended back to the bowler
down the track and another four through the left of mid-off, he wanted to get over the swing, does exactly that, gets off the middle of the bat for four
immediately shortens the length, Badri defends to the covers
edged and four this time, it was outside the off stump, he went down the track, was swinging away, takes the outside edge and it eludes the lone slip, Rohit, goes fine to third-man for four

another dot, maiden over, pitched fuller, into the batsman, who prefers to push it into the covers, goes to extra-cover inside the circle and that is the end of another excellent over from Harbhajan Singh
quicker one into the batsman, carefully pushed to the right of the bowler, who dives well to stop that from going for a single
this time brought out on the front foot, drives, goes on the bounce to the point fielder
and short of length yet again, pushed quicker, angling in from round the stumps, defended to the off side
short again, defended on the back foot to the covers
short, cut and that went quickly to the cover fielder, should have been put away

driven gracefully, more like placed into the gap, pitched and moving away but well played, it looks like it was running away to the fence before that big man makes a big slide, Pollard restricts them to two.
on the middle, bouncing too much, angling into the batsman, he was waiting for the out-swing probably, misses, hits the pad and there is a huge appeal for a wicket, called not-out by the ump
short of length, 138.6 km/hr, hits the bat hard as he defends to the off side
excellent stuff from DK, this was similar to the Vijay dismissal, outside the off stump, swinging away and the only difference was that he missed the edge did Badri
bad ball for a hat-trick ball, down the leg side, no swing, and lets that one go through to the keeper, wide called

inside edge and bowled first ball! what a start from Dhawal Kulkarni, he was nowhere in the team for the first many games, suddenly gets a couple and he is making the ball talk, second wicket for him, it was outside the off stump and there was a bit of wobble, Raina went for a drive, gets an inside edge and is bowled!

edged and gone, swing away and caught in the slips! Lot of swing there from Kulkarni and Vijay was going for a drive, gets an outside edge and that flies off to the lone slip in the form of Rohit Sharma, takes it easily and first blood to Mumbai!
shorter, outside the off stump, hurries on to the batsman, defended on the back foot to the off side

on the back foot, hits his pads and there is a huge appeal from Harbhajan, spinning from round the stumps. The umpire gave it not-out after some doubt whether it hit the bat or directly the pads, replays not too conclusively, but it was close alright
goes down the pitch, gently dabs it away to wide long-on and for a single, Dhawal Kulkarni fields
on the off stump, defended to the covers
shorter from Bhajji, goes on to the back foot, defended to short mid-wicket
round the stumps, on the off stump, hint of spin, pitched up, defended back to the bowler

cometh the match, cometh the Super Kings, they are going home to play Delhi Daredevils in the fight for the final. The last ball is a quick one and it hits the pads, a tame end to Mumbai Indians' campaign.
hit off the back foot through cover
bowled him! Malinga moved outside leg stump and tried to heave across the line, the ball thudded into his back leg and on to leg stump
makes room by moving towards leg and plays towards point
gets down on one knee and slogs the ball into the gap at deep midwicket
that's hit hard and flat to the bowler, Jadeja fails to hold on to the catch, it was a tough chance
he's hit that well, driven with a lot of power wide of the fielder at long off
in the air but short of the fielder running in and sliding from extra cover, Malinga mis-timed the slog over the off side
short ball, Malinga swings and hits it into the stands beyond the midwicket boundary. Too late, too little
driven to long on for a single
in the blockhole outside off, dug out on the off side
good length wide outside off stump, Malinga swings in vain

Pollard tries to hammer a short ball from wide outside off stump, he ends up mis-hitting it high in the air towards long-on, where Raina settles under the catch and takes it. A great moment between the two Trinidadians, Bravo seemed to be telling Pollard to get on a plane. Mumbai Indians are outta here. Pollard took that little send off well, and there were smiles at the end of it. He and Bravo get along.
Malinga moves towards leg and hits the ball flat toward deep cover
Pollard moved towards the off side and got into position to scoop, Bravo bowled a slower full toss, and Pollard did not time it well, he played it to short fine leg
Malinga backs away and swings a length ball through midwicket
a perfect yorker, Pollard digs it out back to the bowler, Bravo stoops on his follow through and the ball goes off his hand on the leg side, Pollard gives Malinga the strike
that was too wide outside off, had Pollard let it go, it might have been called. But he reached for it and hit it with the toe end back to the bowler
he backs away again and tries to hook a short ball, this time he is beaten
Malinga backs away and slogs at a short of a length ball, bashing it over the fielder at mid-off, the ball bounces just before the boundary
the attempted drive is edged towards third man
that's full and too wide outside off stump
in the blockhole outside off, Pollard plays the free hit back to the bowler

it's all over, Mumbai are all but out. Pollard swung hard at a good length ball outside off and inside-edged it on to his stumps. But hang on, Billy Bowden is checking to see if Hilfenhaus had overstepped. So Pollard is waiting. And it is a no-ball! Can you believe it? Nothing was behind the line. So he's back and has a free hit coming up ...
full length and wide outside off, Pollard clears his front foot and swings, but he can't reach the ball
Malinga taps the ball towards point and has to run, because Pollard is thundering down the pitch for a single
a sharp short ball, following Pollard as he moves outside leg, he tries to hook but misses
he's smashed it! A length ball on middle stump, angling into Pollard, who clears his front foot and swings the ball with tremendous force to the midwicket boundary
the yorker, Pollard squeezes it out through the leg side and refuses the single, he needs the strike
now he fails to nudge the ball off his pads and the ball goes towards point, Pollard just charges through for a leg bye
what is Malinga doing? He pushes a good length ball towards extra cover, Pollard stays off strike
defended back to the bowler, another ball Pollard won't face

Pollard's been caught on the deep cover boundary! But Saha, who is on the field for the injured Badri, has tumbled over the rope! Pollard swung hard at a good length ball outside off and sliced it high in the air, Saha back-pedaled and jumped back to take a superb catch but he was over the boundary by then
played off the back foot behind point
a high bouncer, Malinga ducks, but that one was way over his head
short ball outside off, Malinga lets it go through to Dhoni, has he seen what the asking rate is?
Pollard pulls through the leg side for a single, he's hardly had the strike

Raina's taken a superb catch! And Harbhajan's IPL could be over. He slogs again at a short of a length ball outside off and slices it high in the air past point. Raina ran back from inside the circle, kept his eyes on the swirling ball, kept his balance, judged it perfectly, and took it over his head
short of a length outside off stump, Harbhajan's slog across the line connects with nothing
Bravo fires the yorker in at the pads, Pollard misses the flick. Umpire Dharmasena signals for the time out

Harbhajan was a goner had Raina hit from point. He had tapped the ball in front of point and began to run, and then he stopped, and then he continued running. Raina ran to his right, picked up with one hand but missed at the bowler's end
he's been smashed in the face by a short ball, Harbhajan took his eyes off it and turned his head away, Bravo goes to check on him and Harbhajan says he is okay. He was wearing a helmet of course

caught behind! They're edging everything, and Bravo's hamstring seems perfectly fine as he takes off on a spirited celebratory run. Franklin tried to pull a delivery that was not that short and was too close to off stump. He got a bottom edge, which Dhoni stooped to catch
the slower ball outside off, Franklin mis-times it close on the off side, Bravo runs quickly to prevent the single
good length outside off, Pollard drove on the up too early and spooned it in the air towards extra cover, no fielder there
Pollard tries to turn the ball off his pads but misses, the ball goes towards point for a leg bye
short of a length, Franklin pulls towards wide long on to take Mumbai to 100
good length on off stump, Pollard plays the ball with soft hands towards cover and runs a quick single to Raina
driven from the crease to mid off
good length outside off, left alone outside off
nudged off the pads on the leg side once again
nudged off the pads towards midwicket for a single

massive wicket for Super Kings! Rayudu has slog-swept the flighted offbreak straight to Vijay at deep midwicket, who does a little jig after taking the catch. Rayudu has finished many games for Mumbai this season, he won't finish this one. I think Vijay was trying to move like Jagger Bravo
Rayudu was playing for the offbreak but was beaten by the straighter one, he had pushed forward to defend
driven off the front foot through point for another single
driven to long on for a single
Rayudu gets down on one knee and slog sweeps, hitting the ball flat and just out of reach of the fielder at midwicket and into the gap on the boundary
not that time, Ben. A length ball on the pads, Franklin swivels and pulls it flat over the backward square leg boundary
good length on middle and off, Franklin defends on the off side
tries to play the ball off his pads behind square but doesn't make proper contact
no stopping this one, too full on the pads, Rayudu flicks the ball off the front foot through midwicket
a full ball and Rayudu meets it with a wonderful straight drive, Morkel might have got finger tips on it to take pace off the shot, and Vijay ran to his right from long off and slid to save the four
Rohit's edged behind! He charged Morkel and swung hard at a good length ball that pitched around off and seamed away a little. It was a thick outside edge and Dhoni caught it easily.
outside leg stump once again, Rohit connects with the slog sweep, hitting it flat towards deep backward square, where it reaches Badri on the bounce
dabbed on the front foot towards point, Jakati fails to pick up cleanly
Rohit tries to sweep powerfully but makes no contact, the ball pitches outside leg stump from round the wicket and hits the pad
driven towards long on for a single
nudged off the pads behind square
played off the back foot towards the bowler
short of length on the middle stump, he wants to drive it on the up, checks it at the last minute and it goes to long-off, single for Rohit, who is playing himself in.
on his pads, short of length, nudged away to the leg side for a leg-bye
pitched up and driven well by Rohit Sharma, to mid-off, Ashwin dives to his right and misfields and they are able to take a single
short of length, outside the off stump, tries to drive it through, gets an outside edge to third-man
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat to point, straight to the fielder

edged and gone, Karthik's out, caught by the wicket-keeper! It was outside the off stump, deviating slightly away from the batsman and he tried to open the face of the bat through to the third-man, gets only an outside edge and the keeper could not have got it easier.
outside the off stump, defended cautiously and they are away for a single to a ball that goes to point
short of length, punched to the long-on for a single
missed, run-out missed, on his pads, he nudges to the leg side and they are off for a single Jadeja rushes to his right and then fires it to the non-striker's stumps, misses, was miles away
shorter and pulled away in the gap for four through mid-wicket for a four!
shorter, outside the off stump, cut away to the deep covers for a single
quicker one, fired to his pads, flicks his pads and rolls over to the leg side
pitched up, angling in, flicked away to mid-wicket for a single
angling in, flighted up, down the leg side, pushed to the leg side and they are able to take two before the fielder from deep comes in
short of length, outside the off stump, cut away to deep point, where the sweeper has to run to his left and they are able to come back for a second
on the middle stump, pitched fuller, driven back to the bowler

goes for a slog, gone, caught at point! Jakati has bowled well so far to Smith, who has been working him away for singles all this while, this time decides to play a heave over mid-wicket, gets a top edge and is caught by Jadeja pedalling back
on the middle stump, pitched right up and driven to long-off for a single
swept away and that has gone away for four! It was another of those quicker ones, and without too much of back-lift he short-sweeps it through fine-leg to the fence...
continues to not given them any room and bowling really quick, pushed to the leg side for a single
short of length, quicker, pushed to mid-wicket for a single
again one quicker, pushed to the leg side for a single
quicker and hits the pads from round the stumps, Dhoni actually appeals
round the stumps, punched to the leg side and there is no run

gone, Tendulkar is run-out, almost sacrificing it for Smith! That was cut away to the backward point, fielded well by Jadeja, Smith was going for the run and Tendulkar was not, the fielder throws it to the non-striker's end and Tendulkar decides to make that sacrifice by crossing over. In the end, he also speaks to Smith to not worry about it and carry on hitting...!
short of length and pushed to long-on for a single
this time it is slightly shorter, pushed to the covers for a single
finally Tendulkar gets a boundary, goes on to the back foot, quickly shortens the length and cuts it away in the gap for a four!
pitched up, angling in, inside out from Tendulkar and it zips away to the extra-cover, good shot for nothing
outside the off stump, Tendulkar tries to slog sweep it away but straight to mid-wicket, where Murali Vijay fields
slower one, shorter too and Smith goes for another pull, it just does not arrive and is beaten, no harm done though, hits his shoulder
short of length from Hilfy and that has been hit over the deep square-leg fence for a six! Smith's on his motor-bike and going away bonkers!
slower ball outside the off stump, cut away to Bravo in the covers
If Dhoni's helicopter shot was the shot of the tournament, then this comes in the top 10 for sure, short of length and he has jabbed it away over the in field over square-leg for a four!
short of length, wants to go for the pull shot, does not hit him in the middle and it loops up to fine-leg, on the bounce
pitched up outside the off stump and that has been driven over the top for a four! That was rather casually done!
outside the off stump, there was width on that one but he can hit it only straight to the fielder at point
on the middle stump, nudged away to square-leg for a single, good batting from Smith
shorter length, on the stumps, defended to the off side
pitched fuller, on the off stump, angling in as well, driven to long-off for a single
outside the off stump, tries to cut away, gets straight to the point fielder
down the leg side, wants to play a forceful lap shot, misses and the umpire calls it a wide
outside the off stump and Tendulkar waits for it to come on and makes full use of the room, cuts it away through point for a four
top edged for a six! That was short of length and Smith wanted to go over the leg side, he gets a top edge and that has gone over fine third-man for a six!
outside the off stump, swinging away, defended the ball short of length to the off side
bouncer but Smith looks comfortable going under it, wide called because it was too high
inside edge and almost through, keeper dives to his left and stops it
short of length on the middle stump and moving away from the batsman, misses the outside edge and through to the wicket-keeper, good reply from the Aussie
short this time from the bowler and Smith has used a lot of bottom hand to flick it over square-leg for a couple, continuing from where he left off against Hilfy
on the middle stump and flicked away rather well through mid-wicket for a four, it was more of a  push and it races away to the fence
swinging down the leg side for a wide, for some reason the bowler was appealing
short of length, angling in, on to the back foot, punched down to long-on for a single
pitched up from round the stumps, driven through the covers and for a four! Smith's been in some form all this season and he has got off the mark well
short of length on the middle stump, from round the stumps, pushed to the off side
on the middle stump, yorker length, wants to drive it to the right of the bowler, back to the bowler
outside the off stump, turning slightly away, pushed down the ground to long-off for a single
pitched up, outside the off stump, gently tapped to short covers
